legend: The Mothman (Point Pleasant, West Virginia, USA, 1966)
lines: West Virginia, November 1966. Four friends see something that should not exist.
They are driving past an old abandoned factory near Point Pleasant.
In the doorway stands something tall and grey, with huge wings and glowing red eyes.
Legend says it spread its wings and rose into the night.
It chased their car, keeping pace at more than one hundred miles an hour.
They screamed all the way to the police station.
Soon, more people across town reported the same winged shape. They called it the Mothman.
Thirteen months later, the Silver Bridge collapsed into the Ohio River.
Some say the Mothman came to warn the town.
Would you have stopped the car?
title: Four Friends Saw a Winged Creature With Red Eyes... 🦋🔴 #shorts
description:
In November 1966, four friends near Point Pleasant, West Virginia saw a huge winged figure with glowing red eyes. Soon the whole town was talking about the Mothman. This is the legend, as people tell it.
